name: Shenyang Blue Silver Industry Automation Equipment Co., Ltd
summary: Shenyang Blue Silver Industry Automation Equipment Co., Ltd engages in the industrial cleaning and surface treatment, and industrial intelligent mechanical equipment manufacturing businesses in China. The company is involved in researching, developing, producing, and selling cleaning technology applications and surface treatment field equipment products, systems, and solutions. It also provides general multi-piece cleaning and special single-piece cleaning equipment, and precision cleaning systems for medical, precision, and high-tech cleaning industries.
